name: When is the best time of year to schedule a tile or surface update?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time of year to schedule a tile or surface update?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tile and surface updates can be scheduled year-round, as most of the work is performed indoors. However, some clients prefer scheduling during off-peak seasons (late fall to early spring) when contractors might have more availability. For projects involving extensive demolition or external work, temperate weather can be beneficial. Consider your personal schedule and project urgency when planning.
acceptedAnswer.description: Tile and surface updates can be done any time of year, but some prefer off-peak seasons for contractor availability.
